description: A harness that goes round, carrying a total and performing a call chosen at run time, and a loop with problems.

request.source:
harness climb(goal: Int) -> Int
uses m = "math", b = "brain"
carry total: Int = 0
choice = b.choose(total: total)
more = perform choice
said = match more { ok(r) => str(r), _ => "" }
next total = total + len(said) + 1
return total when total >= goal
otherwise return total

harness broken(goal: Int) -> Int
uses m = "math"
carry total: Int = goal
step = m.double(n: total)
next goal = step
return total
otherwise return 0
